_comment: The on-camera candidate: a real, live, well-behaved MCP server whose job
Clembot ALREADY does. WebZum hosts generated web content, and it grades A
on configuration, so nothing about it is a security story. That is the
point: the doorman declines because the system does not need it, not
Chosen against the REAL roster, not invented. Clembot has url-unfurler and
feed-fetcher, and three more agents holding WebFetch, so the overlap list
writes itself from names Clemens actually runs.
